source_title: MEDKids Spine starter card (demonstration data, unreviewed)
primary_objective: How the spine supports and protects
educational_content: The spine is also called the backbone. The spine is made of small bones called vertebrae. The spine helps hold the body up. The spine protects the spinal cord, which carries messages between the brain and the body. Soft discs between the vertebrae let the spine bend.
learning_objectives: The spine is made of small bones called vertebrae.
The spine helps hold the body up.
The spine protects the spinal cord.

forbidden_claims.claim: The spine is one single bone
